rule: owner 10-17 boundary match: pin-flop spread <=80 at TT+FF and neighbour-matched boundary by parent compensation; landed-regions standard 10-18 (frame = 3 landed regions)
q_links: per slot k: u_e<k> <-> dsfd_qbank_S u_bs<k> (cfg/go/x inputs), dsfd_qbank_N u_bn<k> (pv/pval/... outputs, busy/fault), ot_s81_cfg7_seq u_s<k> (bank_free/sh_free/go_tag); rst_n = synchronous (RSTP=1, relay flop at pin)
scheme: PARENT COMPENSATION inside each frame region: the q elements take the region clock at the region root (no added delay); every other sink of the region (qbank_S/N, cfg7_seq + its cfg ROMs, nodes, sstn stations, relays, cfifo side) hangs off ONE shared trunk delay line of D_TT so its pin flops arrive with the q pin flops. Region-to-region and frame boundary crossings stay LANDED (frame_l4 plan, 3 regions). No extra landings, no data cycles.

trunk_delay_ps.basis: buffer chain assumed to track the q tree FF/TT ratio (q 407.2/510.3; neighbours 0.79-0.80)

fallback: if frame CTS cannot hold the pairs <=80 at both corners: LAND the q pins (739 b/slot, 12 slots/frame: ~8.9k b, ~35k landing flops/frame, +3 edges on the q path) or split the leaf (HARD-REVIEW option, only if frame STA names it)
ck_face: closed view clk on S (x 231, M5); HF-1 gate with clk at N centre: spread TT 35.7 / FF 27.6 (results/rtl/dsrom_qelem_pq_20261006/hf1_ckn_1018). Binding the N variant needs one re-route; the frame tap uses whichever view binds (S now).
reset: frames re-emitted RSTP=1 (claude/hf1-qxpq-1018 5ebaa6d4d); q internal reset releases 1 edge after the frame reset; frame bench (L4, each + plan) proves the return calendar unchanged -> no reset-calendar change needed if PASS

chosen.note: neighbours deliberately ~40 ps (TT) / ~36 ps (FF) later than the q boundary mean (useful skew for the q output pin flops). Thin: launch margin 1.7 ps, mismatch margin 12.6 TT. Frame STA must confirm the q->qbank_N / q->cfg7_seq FF hold (neighbour capture later by ~36 ps FF).

native_relative.structural_followup: NS-QXPQ plan (output pin-flop band at the N face, hold padding at the pin, x2/x3 drive) restores launch to ~150-200 at C=489: combine it with OT_Q_CK_NORTH=1 in ONE re-route (reroute_reason native_launch + contract clock face) so C can drop back to the q mean.
